location: Player Setup, steps 10–11; Phase A, Way of Life; Rules for 2 Players, Setup
firstPlayerRule: With three or four players, whoever visited Japan most recently is the first month's starting player. With two players, randomly assign the Sun and Moon tokens; the Sun player starts the first month.
officialTieBreak: In the three- or four-player setup, choose randomly if nobody has visited Japan.
clarifications: The starter chooses an Ikizama space first. The chosen spaces then determine the action order, so the setup starter does not necessarily take the first action.
For the first month's choice order, the starting player's firefighting marker is on top of the stack, with the other markers underneath in clockwise order.
uncertainty: No separate tie-break is stated for equally recent visits to Japan.
evidenceNotes: The publisher PDF's text layer is garbled. Player setup, phase order and the two-player Sun/Moon override were read from rendered pages.
